name: Agent document
description: An agent as a Hypermedia resource: a typed document that IS the agent on the network. Its metadata binds the agent's configuration via agentDefinition (an ipfs reference to an agent-definition blob, the same pattern schemaDefinition uses for schemas), and its content is the agent's public description. Permissions (owner, collaborators, public read/chat) are NOT modeled here: an agent document is an ordinary resource in the resource tree and inherits the hierarchical permission rules of the Resource system.

agentDefinition.description: This document defines an agent: the ipfs cid of the agent-definition blob holding its configuration.
